title: Workforce
description: Restricted attendance view. Requires factory_workforce index access. May show first names from the roster KV Store.

options.query: | inputlookup flo_kv_sites | table site_id, site_name | rename site_id as value, site_name as label

`factory_workforce_indexes` sourcetype=factory:personnel:exception site="$tok_site$" shift_id="$tok_shift$" earliest=-24h
| lookup flo_kv_roster worker_id OUTPUT first_name, station_id, role
| table _time, site, line_id, station_id, worker_id, first_name, action, event_message
| sort -_time

`factory_workforce_indexes` sourcetype=factory:shift:clock site="$tok_site$" shift_id="$tok_shift$" earliest=-24h
| stats latest(action) as action, min(eval(if(action="clock_in",_time,null()))) as first_in, max(_time) as last_event by worker_id, line_id
| lookup flo_kv_roster worker_id OUTPUT first_name, planned_start, planned_end, role
| table worker_id, first_name, role, line_id, action, first_in, last_event, planned_start, planned_end
